newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rotterdam-based Turkish bank gets $45 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam-based Turkish bank gets $45 mln loan.

text.p: Rotterdam-based Demir-Halk Bank, a joint-venture by Turkey's state-owned Halkbank and the private Demirbank, said it had secured a $45 million, one-year syndication loan from international markets.

The loan, with an interest rate of LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate) plus 75 basis points, was arranged by Rabobank Utrecht, Standard Chartered Bank London, Sumitomo Bank London and West LB Dusseldorf, Demir-Halk said in a statement.
It said the loan would be used to finance Turkey's imports from Europe.
Demir-Halk Bank has operated with three branches in the Netherlands since 1993.
